settings.arrow_spacing.help: Gap between the direction arrows drawn along a route (higher = more spread out).
settings.controller_mode.help: GameHelper auto-detects controller mode, so you normally don't need this. Tick it only to FORCE the controller Atlas layout if auto-detect ever fails. Either way the plugin falls back to the other layout when the selected one isn't found. In controller mode the overlay also stays visible while the inventory is open.
settings.draw_paths.help: Master switch for this group: when off, no route is drawn for any of its content, but each entry keeps its own 'route' checkbox unchanged.
settings.hide_available_maps.help: Hide maps that are accessible/runnable right now. Route/search targets stay visible.
settings.language.help: Display language for map-node names (from maps.json 'translates'). Changing it re-labels nodes immediately. Map Group names are matched in the selected language.
settings.max_hops.help: Max hops to route through (0 = unlimited). A longer route is suppressed.
settings.route.help: Draw a route to the nearest node carrying this content.
settings.search_map.hint: You can search multiple maps at once using a comma separator ','
settings.shortest_path.help: Route lines follow the shortest hop-path through the revealed atlas edges (from the nearest accessible node). When off, a straight line is drawn instead.
settings.show_content_icons.help: Draws each content as its in-game icon (from Plugins\Atlas\icons\<name>.png) above the map name. Content without an icon file falls back to its text name. Icons are suppressed on visible nodes (the game already draws them there) and shown only on hidden ones.
settings.show_node_index.help: DEBUG: draws each node's child-index (its number in the atlas-panel child list) as a badge to the left of the map name, so a node referenced by number is easy to locate on-screen.
settings.universal_font: Universal font (render map names in any language)
settings.universal_font.help: Loads the plugin's bundled DejaVuSans + GNU Unifont into the overlay so any-language map names render without configuring a font in GameHelper. Affects the whole overlay; turning it off restores GameHelper's configured font.
